RandomX in the browser — third-party notices
============================================

This folder ships a WebAssembly build of RandomX (RandomX / WebRandomX).
The HTML, CSS and JavaScript of the Browser Experiment are proprietary
(© 2026 VoltMiner, all rights reserved; no licence granted).

Files
-----
web-randomx-mt.js / web-randomx-mt.wasm   pthread build, one shared ~2 GB dataset
web-randomx.js    / web-randomx.wasm      single-thread fallback (no SharedArrayBuffer)

web-randomx-mt is built from https://github.com/aa022/RandomX-bonanza @ f9848e3
(a WebAssembly JIT backend on the RandomX engine) with Emscripten 4.0.10, plus
the patches in third_party/RandomX-JIT-overlay/.
web-randomx is built from https://github.com/WebCryptomining/WebRandomX @
780908a with Emscripten 4.0.10, plus the patches in
third_party/WebRandomX-overlay/.

Full licence texts are published at notices.html (served next to this page).

Notes
-----
- Do not hotlink a third-party wasm at runtime; both binaries are committed here.
- The relay hop lives in tools/web-stratum-bridge, on our own VPS. Browsers cannot
  open the pool's TLS stratum socket, so the relay forwards the WebSocket to it and
  rewrites nothing in either direction.
- This page mines to the visitor's own wallet and takes 0% of the hashrate.
